recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Reintroducing a DiagnosticOrder-specific edit or narrowing ServiceRequest.supportingInfo back to Observation/Condition would contradict the active build scope and later OO decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-3113 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification OO change request against DiagnosticRequest/DiagnosticOrder asking for linked supporting observations on lab requests. The approved Phoenix WGM resolution was to leave clinicalNotes as-is and add SupportingInformation 0..* referencing Observation and Condition.
initial_application: Commit 559fc97f010d1d5bce29b28f0023788f30f723d7 added DiagnosticOrder.supportingInformation 0..* Resource(Observation|Condition) and tagged the spreadsheet row with [#3113]. The current ServiceRequest source still carries the #3113 committee-note lineage on ServiceRequest.supportingInfo.
additional_context: Later request-pattern and resource-merge work renamed supportingInformation to supportingInfo and carried DiagnosticRequest/ProcedureRequest into active ServiceRequest. source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as an active approved resource and records DiagnosticOrder as subsumed into ServiceRequest. Related same-element decisions broadened and clarified the element: FHIR-3739 added DocumentReference, FHIR-7135 clarified that AOEs and discrete observations are supporting information, FHIR-37355 changed ServiceRequest.supportingInfo from Reference(Resource) to CodeableReference(Resource), and FHIR-31589 clarified that supportingInfo is existing clinical context while orderDetail is used for instructions/questions to be performed.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. ServiceRequest.supportingInfo is 0..*, has definition text covering diagnosis, clinical findings, other observations, and explicitly requested AOE observations, and is typed as CodeableReference(Resource), which includes Observation and Condition references while preserving later approved broadening.
